items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Tuts Johnson was there? Tuts Johnson was there at the time. Yeah. But you didn't have him.

ctx.x: I know Handy used to come to reserve and play all the time from Baton Rouge, you know.

And what about Robert Thomas, Bob Thomas, was he around Baton Rouge, then? I can't remember. He's a trombone player, you might not remember him at all. No. And Tuts Johnson was there? Tuts Johnson was there at the time. Yeah. But you didn't have him.
